verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a manual evidence path: attaching an evidence file to a document and submitting it for review. It also documents owner assignment on resources and controls. Due dates, renewal reminders and expiry tracking for manual artifacts are not evidenced; the reminders claim concerns risk assessments, which is a different feature. Missing for 10: due dates on manual evidence, renewal reminders, expiry tracking on every artifact, explicit per-document owner assignment, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact

citations.quote: Attach an evidence file to a Vanta document and submit it for review, using the Manage Vanta API.
